description:
Prepare your Torah reading with a tikkun, recorded aliyot, and a practice view that keeps your place.

READ YOUR WAY
Read with nekudot and cantillation, then hide them to practice. Pasuk numbers stay visible. Choose flowing Reading layout or Match layout, with one-sided and paired views, adjustable text, and light or dark appearance.

LISTEN AND PRACTICE
Listen to available aliyah recordings by Yoni Davidov. Follow word highlighting where synchronized timing is published, adjust playback speed, and return to the reading you were practicing. Audio and word-timing coverage vary by reading.

TAKE READINGS OFFLINE
Torah text is included in the app. Download available audio by aliyah or parsha from Media, see which recordings are saved, and remove or re-download them from Storage. Audio downloads require an internet connection.

KEEP THE NEXT READING CLOSE
Browse upcoming Shabbat and special-day readings with Israel or Diaspora calendar settings. Add the Parsha & Practice Home Screen widget to see the next Shabbat reading and return to your practice. Use the Get Upcoming Readings action in Shortcuts for one to five reading names, dates, and Torah verse references.

No account is required to read or practice.

Recordings by Yoni Davidov, used with permission. Calendar calculations use Hebcal. Home Screen widgets require iOS 17 or later; Shortcuts requires iOS 16 or later.
promotionalText: Read, listen, and practice your next aliyah. Save available recordings for offline use, keep your place, and bring the next Shabbat reading to your Home Screen.
